entries.title: Luke 7:1
segments: ¶And when he had completed all his words in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

entries.title: Luke 7:2
segments: And a certain centurion's bondman who was dear to him was ill and about to die;

entries.title: Luke 7:3
segments: and having heard of Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, begging him that he might come and save his bondman.

entries.title: Luke 7:4
segments: But they, being come to Jesus, besought him diligently, saying, He is worthy to whom thou shouldest grant this,

entries.title: Luke 7:5
segments: for he loves our nation, and himself has built the synagogue for us.

entries.title: Luke 7:6
segments: And Jesus went with them. But already, when he was not far from the house, the centurion sent to him friends, saying to him, Lord, do not trouble thyself, for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof.

entries.title: Luke 7:7
segments: Wherefore neither did I count myself worthy to come to thee. But say by a word and my servant shall be healed.

entries.title: Luke 7:8
segments: For *I* also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers, and I say to this [one], Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my bondman, Do this, and he does [it].

entries.title: Luke 7:9
segments: And Jesus hearing this wondered at him, and turning to the crowd following him said, I say to you, Not even in Israel have I found so great faith.

entries.title: Luke 7:10
segments: And they who had been sent returning to the house found the bondman, who was ill, in good health.

entries.title: Luke 7:11
segments: ¶And it came to pass afterwards he went into a city called Nain, and many of his disciples and a great crowd went with him.

entries.title: Luke 7:12
segments: And as he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, a dead man was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she a widow, and a very considerable crowd of the city [was] with her.

entries.title: Luke 7:13
segments: And the Lord, seeing her, was moved with compassion for her, and said to her, Weep not;

entries.title: Luke 7:14
segments: and coming up he touched the bier, and the bearers stopped. And he said, Youth, I say to thee, Wake up.

entries.title: Luke 7:15
segments: And the dead sat up and began to speak; and he gave him to his mother.

entries.title: Luke 7:16
segments: And fear seized on all, and they glorified God, saying, A great prophet has been raised up amongst us; and God has visited his people.

entries.title: Luke 7:17
segments: And this report went out in all Judaea concerning him, and in all the surrounding country.

entries.title: Luke 7:18
segments: And the disciples of John brought him word concerning all these things:

entries.title: Luke 7:19
segments: ¶and John, having called two of his disciples, sent to Jesus, saying, Art *thou* he that is coming, or are we to wait for another?

entries.title: Luke 7:20
segments: But the men having come to him said, John the baptist has sent us to thee, saying, Art *thou* he that is coming, or are we to wait for another?

entries.title: Luke 7:21
segments: In that hour he healed many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits, and to many blind he granted sight.

entries.title: Luke 7:22
segments: And Jesus answering said to them, Go, bring back word to John of what ye have seen and heard: that blind see, lame walk, lepers are cleansed, deaf hear, dead are raised, poor are evangelized;

entries.title: Luke 7:23
segments: and blessed is whosoever shall not be offended in me.

entries.title: Luke 7:24
segments: And the messengers of John having departed, he began to speak to the crowds concerning John: What went ye out into the wilderness to behold? a reed shaken by the wind?

entries.title: Luke 7:25
segments: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in delicate garments? Behold, those who are in splendid clothing and live luxuriously are in the courts of kings.

entries.title: Luke 7:26
segments: But what went ye out to see? a prophet? Yea, I say to you, and [what is] more excellent than a prophet.

entries.title: Luke 7:27
segments: This is he concerning whom it is written, Behold, *I* send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee;

entries.title: Luke 7:28
segments: for I say unto you, Among them that are born of women a greater [prophet] is no one than John [the baptist]; but he who is a little one in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

entries.title: Luke 7:29
segments: (And all the people who heard [it], and the tax-gatherers, justified God, having been baptised with the baptism of John;

entries.title: Luke 7:30
segments: but the Pharisees and the lawyers rendered null as to themselves the counsel of God, not having been baptised by him.)

entries.title: Luke 7:31
segments: To whom therefore shall I liken the men of this generation, and to whom are they like?

entries.title: Luke 7:32
segments: They are like children sitting in the market-place, and calling one to another and saying, We have piped to you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

entries.title: Luke 7:33
segments: For John the baptist has come neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and ye say, He has a demon.

entries.title: Luke 7:34
segments: The Son of man has come eating and drinking, and ye say, Behold an eater and wine-drinker, a friend of tax-gatherers and sinners;

entries.title: Luke 7:35
segments: and wisdom has been justified of all her children.

entries.title: Luke 7:36
segments: ¶But one of the Pharisees begged him that he would eat with him. And entering into the house of the Pharisee he took his place at table;

entries.title: Luke 7:37
segments: and behold, a woman in the city, who was a sinner, and knew that he was sitting at meat in the house of the Pharisee, having taken an alabaster box of myrrh,

entries.title: Luke 7:38
segments: and standing at his feet behind [him] weeping, began to wash his feet with tears; and she wiped them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed [them] with the myrrh.

entries.title: Luke 7:39
segments: And the Pharisee who had invited him, seeing it, spoke with himself saying, This [person] if he were a prophet would have known who and what the woman is who touches him, for she is a sinner.

entries.title: Luke 7:40
segments: And Jesus answering said to him, Simon, I have somewhat to say to thee. And he says, Teacher, say [it].

entries.title: Luke 7:41
segments: There were two debtors of a certain creditor: one owed five hundred denarii and the other fifty;

entries.title: Luke 7:42
segments: but as they had nothing to pay, he forgave both of them [their debt]: [say,] which of them therefore will love him most?

entries.title: Luke 7:43
segments: And Simon answering said, I suppose he to whom he forgave the most. And he said to him, Thou hast rightly judged.

entries.title: Luke 7:44
segments: And turning to the woman he said to Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thy house; thou gavest me not water on my feet, but *she* has washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with her hair.

entries.title: Luke 7:45
segments: Thou gavest me not a kiss, but *she* from the time I came in has not ceased kissing my feet.

entries.title: Luke 7:46
segments: My head with oil thou didst not anoint, but *she* has anointed my feet with myrrh.

entries.title: Luke 7:47
segments: For which cause I say to thee, Her many sins are forgiven; for she loved much; but he to whom little is forgiven loves little.

entries.title: Luke 7:48
segments: And he said to her, Thy sins are forgiven.

entries.title: Luke 7:49
segments: And they that were with [them] at table began to say within themselves, Who is this who forgives also sins?

entries.title: Luke 7:50
segments: And he said to the woman, Thy faith has saved thee; go in peace.
